metadata.selection_rule_text:
def is_text_reading_question(q: str) -> bool:
    q_low = q.lower().strip()
    direct_patterns = [
        "what does this say",
        "what does it say",
        "what does the label",
        "what does this label",
        "what does the bottle",
        "what does the box",
        "what is written",
        "what is this written",
        "read",
        "expiration",
        "how much",
        "price",
        "dosage",
        "how many mg",
        "what kind of",
        "what flavor"
    ]
    for p in direct_patterns:
        if p in q_low:
            return True
    if "what is this" in q_low:
        targets = ["bottle", "box", "can", "label", "package", "medicine", "pill"]
        if any(t in q_low for t in targets):
            return True
    return False
